talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of biodiversity. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life found on Earth, including different species of plants, animals, and microorganisms. It is crucial for ecosystem health, providing services such as pollination, water purification, and climate regulation. High biodiversity can enhance resilience to environmental changes and support human well-being. However, human activities, such as deforestation and pollution, are threatening biodiversity worldwide. Conservation efforts aim to protect ecosystems and promote sustainable practices to preserve this vital resource for future generations.

questions.explain: 生物多樣性是地球上生命的多樣性。
生物多樣性對於氣候調節非常重要。
城市化、森林砍伐和氣候變化都威脅著生物多樣性。

questions.q: What do conservation efforts aim to do?
questions.explain: 保護工作旨在保護生態系統。
